name: Andorhal market gate, the queue and the carter's yard outside the wall
region: Andorhal, south road side; the smaller of the city's two gates

sensoryProfile.sight: A queue of wagons running back up the road past the first houses, teams standing hipshot in the traces. Chest-high field-stone wall, mortar crumbling and patched; a boy could go over with a tailboard for a ladder. Two militia in the arch with iron grain spikes; a third on the wall walk with his back half turned; a table inside the arch with a clerk and a board of wax seals. Grain trickling off tailboards onto pale cobbles, cracks packed full.
sensoryProfile.sound: Iron tyres, somebody hammering at a hoop, the clerk's nib chattering, the guard's 'Move on.'
sensoryProfile.smell: Warm grain, dry and sweet, like bread before it goes in the oven.
sensoryProfile.touch: Boot-packed mud at the threshold; last sun flat across the back of the neck; shade under the arch where Jaina's lip draws back from her teeth.
sensoryProfile.atmosphere: A gate made of paper: nothing to climb, everything to be counted. Whether the tightness is the town waking up or someone screening the grain, Sylvanas cannot tell.

establishedFacts.fact: The Thalassian horses are stabled in a carter's yard outside the wall (the mare went sideways all the way down the hill and shied at the yard gate; Lyriel lifted Jaina off in the straw). Sylvanas wrote the pass on the lid of the ostler's feed bin with his pen and sealed it in wax softened at his lamp.

Gate procedure: the clerk takes the yard's seal from the bill and checks it against the board, then writes the wagon in the book; guards spike every sack ('Since the Exchange said'). Foot passengers: the clerk asks name, business, any business with granaries (buying or selling, a factor, the guild, a yard), carrying grain/flour/meal/seed/malt, how long. Names are written in a book that lies open on a table in a gate, 'where anyone with a reason could turn back a page and find it'.

The party's entry: 'Proudmoore, Dalaran, Kirin Tor. Escort, Farstriders, three.' plus Sylvanas's name copied off the pass. Jaina told the clerk she is to report to the Kirin Tor house in the mage quarter.

Watchers: five (two with spikes in the arch, one on the walk who does not look at the road, two sitting by the trough inside; four of the five watch the wagons). Inside the arch the street is loud with iron tyres; the carts bear left down a broad lane to the granaries; a man in a brown coat and cap on an upturned barrel chalks every wagon that turns down it.

eventsHere.event: The four enter on foot under Sylvanas's Farstrider pass; Jaina answers the clerk; the party is recorded in the gate book.
